conditions: signed-in customer with no orders placed navigates to order history page
items.expected: Order history page loads and displays the heading 'Order History' with an empty state message

conditions: signed-in customer enters a valid order number into the track-order form and submits
items.expected: Track result page displays the order's status and product details

conditions: signed-in customer navigates directly to the order history page
items.expected: Order history page shows only orders belonging to the current user (empty list when no orders placed)

conditions: unauthenticated user navigates directly to the order history URL
items.expected: The order history page is not accessible without authentication; the user is redirected away or shown no order data

conditions: unauthenticated user navigates to track-order page and enters a known order number
items.expected: Order tracking requires authentication; an unauthenticated user cannot see order details by entering an order number

conditions: signed-in customer is on the order history page
axe-core scans the mat-card or main content area with WCAG 2.1 A and AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported for rule IDs checked (violations array is empty)
